name: kafe-adisyon-sistemi
description: React, Express ve PostgreSQL ile geliştirilen web tabanlı kafe adisyon sistemi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @kafe/api" "npm run dev -w @kafe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kafe/contracts && npm run build -w @kafe/api && npm run build -w @kafe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kafe/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @kafe/api && npm run typecheck -w @kafe/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @kafe/contracts && npm run test -w @kafe/api && npm run test -w @kafe/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
